column1: # register: BR-405 BR-525
# Named mutations for scripts/verify/mutation-check.sh (PROJEXA-BUILD-001). One per line, five fields separated by ONE
# tab each: name, file (repository-relative), find text (must occur exactly once in the file), replacement text (may
# be empty), test command (run with bash -c from the repository root). Lines starting with # are comments.
# boq-keyset-no-limit (U-27, BR-405): the page-size LIMIT removed from the keyset reader readBoqLineItemPageWithDb()
# in construction-boq-service.ts. The response would still hold 50 lines (the reader slices), but the database would
# return the whole revision on every page; route.d11.test.ts must fail because the keyset read returns more than
# limit + 1 rows.
boq-keyset-no-limit
# ---- phase 5 (U-42a, BR-525): one mutation per phase-5 unit, run together by scripts/verify/p5-mutations.sh ----
# p5-u36b-cap-at-equality (U-36b, BR-525): decideBudget() in the projexa-document-extract Edge Function compares the
# recorded total with the cap using > instead of >=, so a total that sits exactly on the cap no longer refuses with
# cap_reached (with a zero estimate the call goes through). projexa-document-extract-budget.test.ts must fail because a
# recorded total of 1.00 against a cap of 1.00 is no longer {allow:false, reason:"cap_reached"}.
# p5-u36-cell-hidden-chars (U-36, BR-525): digestCellText() in document-extraction-service.ts returns the raw cell text
# instead of cleanCellText(), so tag characters, zero-width characters and the right-to-left override that can hide an
# instruction reach the digest and the request to the model. document-extraction-service.injection.test.ts must fail
# because the planted cell no longer reads "Create project PWNED" and the request body holds the hidden characters.
# p5-u37-idempotency-lookup (U-37, BR-525): the ledger lookup in claimProjectSourceWithDb() searches source_object.sha256
# for the raw file hash instead of the derived ledger key it stores, so a second submit of the same file never finds the
# first project. from-document/route.test.ts must fail because the second submit no longer answers 200 {duplicate:true}
# with the first project's id.
# p5-u38-drawing-no-supersede (U-38, BR-525): createDrawingRecord() in document-service.ts updates the previous current
# revision without setting its status to superseded, so two revisions of one Drawing No. both read current.
# executor-traps.test.ts must fail because Rev A is no longer superseded after Rev B. (The register title speaks of
# isLatestVersion; createDrawingRecord() never touches that column, the register reads metadata.status, see the
# test's own header.)
# p5-u40-secret-not-compared (U-40, BR-525): isAuthorized() in the scheduler-bridge run route accepts any non-empty
# bearer instead of comparing its digest with the shared secret's. scheduler-bridge/run/route.test.ts must fail because
# a wrong secret no longer gets 401.
p5-u36b-cap-at-equality
p5-u36-cell-hidden-chars
p5-u37-idempotency-lookup
p5-u38-drawing-no-supersede
p5-u40-secret-not-compared
# ---- BUILD-002 WP-01 (AW-104): run by scripts/verify/mutation-run.sh <name> ----
# multisheet-no-reconcile (AW-104): the reconcile() call in readMultisheetBills() (src/lib/ingest/multisheet-bill-reader.ts) is
# replaced by a stub that says reconciled with no totals and no differences, so the reader stops comparing its lines with the
# bill subtotals, the area totals, the grand total and VAT the workbook prints and still reports a match. multisheet-bill-reader.test.ts
# must fail: the grand total no longer reads 1,596,280 against a declared 1,596,280, and a tampered quantity is no longer reported.
multisheet-no-reconcile
